items.t: Cracked plastic intake manifold coolant passage
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the engine overheated.

items.t: Cruise control deactivation switch can start an underhood fire (recall)
items.job: Replace cruise deactivation switch and add fused jumper
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.
Ford ran a coverage program for this module. Ask a dealer with your VIN; rebuilt modules cost less.

items.t: Rear wheel bearing and axle shaft wear on police and fleet cars (recall)
items.job: Replace rear axle shaft, bearing and seal
items.note: Price is per side. Covered by recall for affected cars; check your VIN first.

items.t: Steel wheels can crack near the weld (police and taxi)
items.job: Replace cracked steel wheel and mount tire
items.note: Price is per wheel. Ask a Ford dealer whether any wheel program applies to your VIN.

items.t: Insulation pad can sag onto the catalytic converter (police and taxi recall)
items.job: Remove or replace floor insulation pad
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Transmission slips from a cracked forward clutch cylinder
items.job: Rebuild or replace transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: An in-shop rebuild can cost about the same. Torque converter and cooler flush are usually included.

items.t: Rusted steering shaft can cause loss of steering (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall in salt-belt states. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Coolant leak where the intake manifold meets the aluminum crossover
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the engine overheated.

items.job: Replace transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: A fluid service or valve body repair sometimes fixes milder slipping for much less.

items.t: Loss of overdrive on police and long-wheelbase taxi cars
items.note: Have it diagnosed first; a solenoid or wiring fault can be much cheaper to fix.
Mail-in cluster repair services often cost less than a new cluster.
